say:1:1660204001:0.source_cn: 女神在上，多亏了几位的帮助！

say:2:1660204002:1.text: What's a Hypofiend doing in a theater? Granted, it wasn't exactly a fearsome one...
say:2:1660204002:1.source_cn: 剧团里怎么会有魔物？虽然不怎么强就是了。

say:3:1660204003:1.text: That was too close. Is everyone alright? Anyone hurt?
say:3:1660204003:1.source_cn: 太危险了，剧团里的人还好吗，有没有人受伤？

say:4:1660204004:1.text: No one's hurt, but I don't think we'll be finishing rehearsal today.
say:4:1660204004:1.source_cn: 没有人受伤，但是今天的排演应该没办法继续了。

say:6:1660204005:0.text: Something about this doesn't sit right with me... Has anything unusual been happening lately?
say:6:1660204005:0.source_cn: 我有种奇怪的感觉……有什么特殊的事情发生吗？

say:7:1660204006:0.text: Now that you mention it... yeah. Lately, a bunch of folks have been unusually drowsy.
say:7:1660204006:0.source_cn: 特殊的事情……呃，说来奇怪，最近不少人都觉得特别困。

say:8:1660204007:0.text: Just earlier, a few lead actors nodded off in the middle of the rehearsal. Nothing could wake them.
say:8:1660204007:0.source_cn: 刚才更是，一连几个主演都睡着了，怎么叫都叫不醒。

say:9:1660204008:1.text: It could just be overwork. Maybe they need a break.
say:9:1660204008:1.source_cn: 是不是演出太辛苦了，要不要给大家放假休息一下呢？

choice_prompt:10:1660204008.text: It could just be overwork. Maybe they need a break.
choice_prompt:10:1660204008.source_cn: 是不是演出太辛苦了，要不要给大家放假休息一下呢？

say:11:1660204009:0.source_cn: 并非如此，这件事恐怕另有隐情。

say:12:1660204010:0.text: With all that noise and chaos, even a hibernating hornleaf bear would've snapped awake.
say:12:1660204010:0.source_cn: 刚才的声音太过嘈杂，魔物制造的骚乱和战斗的声响足以唤醒...

choice_prompt:13:1660204010.text: With all that noise and chaos, even a hibernating hornleaf bear would've snapped awake.
choice_prompt:13:1660204010.source_cn: 刚才的声音太过嘈杂，魔物制造的骚乱和战斗的声响足以唤醒冬眠的叶角熊。

narration:14:1660204011:0.text: Before Ludovic can say more, the floor gives way. You all fall—down, down, into darkness with no end in sight...
narration:14:1660204011:0.source_cn: 话音未落，你脚下一空，直直坠落下去，仿佛落入了无尽的深渊……
narration:14:1660204011:0.male: Before Ludovic can say more, the floor gives way. You all fall—down, down, into darkness with no end in sight...
narration:14:1660204011:0.female: Before Ludovic can say more, the floor gives way. You all fall—down, down, into darkness with no end in sight...

choice:13:0:1.text: There's no way anyone could sleep through that!
choice:13:0:1.source_cn: 在这种情况下，不可能有人睡得着！
choice:13:0:1.male: There's no way anyone could sleep through that!
choice:13:0:1.female: There's no way anyone could sleep through that!

choice:10:0:1.text: Even heroes like Merlin need to rest sometimes.
choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 没错，即便是大英雄梅林也需要休息
choice:10:0:1.male: Even heroes like Merlin need to rest sometimes.
choice:10:0:1.female: Even heroes like Merlin need to rest sometimes.

choice:10:1:2.text: Something more sinister is going on.
choice:10:1:2.male: Something more sinister is going on.
choice:10:1:2.female: Something more sinister is going on.
